title: clematis brevicaudata var. ganpiniana
intro: Clematis brevicaudata var. ganpiniana, commonly known as Ganpinian Clematis or Tian Keng, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the clematis family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Clematis brevicaudata var. ganpiniana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
